name: Pyrénées - Mont Perdu
description: Straddling the French-Spanish border in the central Pyrenees, this mixed site is centred on Mont Perdu, a limestone massif rising to 3,352 metres. On the Spanish side, two of Europe's biggest and deepest canyons cut into the mountains, while steep cirque walls loom over the French side. Villages, fields and high summer pastures still reflect a traditional mountain farming life that has vanished elsewhere in Europe.
